timeThreshold.label: Repost check window
timeThreshold.helpText: select how far back you want DejaRepost to look

enforcementAction.label: Enforcement action
enforcementAction.helpText: Choose what action DejaRepost takes when a match is found

imageTolerance.label: Image Reposts Matching Tolerance
imageTolerance.helpText: Set it to 99 → an image needs to be 99% similar to get flagged → only near-identical duplicates trigger it → strict, exact-match required.

videoTolerance.label: Video Reposts Matching Tolerance
videoTolerance.helpText: Set it to 99 → a video needs to be 99% similar to get flagged → only near-identical duplicates trigger it → strict, exact-match required.

textTolerance.label: Text Reposts Matching Tolerance
textTolerance.helpText: Set it to 99 → a video needs to be 99% similar to get flagged → only near-identical duplicates trigger it → strict, exact-match required.
